map.单台日运行能耗 = 额定功率 × 载重系数(0.3 + 0.7×载重率%÷100: Daily running energy per unit = rated power × load factor (0.3 + 0.7 × load rate % ÷ 100) × trip duration × trips per day, with trip duration = floors crossed × floor height ÷ 1.6 (fixed assumed speed in m/s) ÷ 3600 to hours; daily standby energy per unit = standby power × standby hours; total daily energy = (running + standby) × units, monthly ×30, yearly ×365, electricity cost = energy × tariff. Validation: no hard check; non-numeric inputs count as 0. Criteria: a load rate of 0-100% makes the factor vary linearly between 0.3 and 1.0.

Daily running energy per lift = rated power × load factor (0.3 + 0.7×load rate%÷100) × time per trip × daily trips × (1+start-stop%) × (1−regeneration%); time per trip = floors per trip × floor height ÷ actual average speed ÷ 3600; standby = standby power × standby hours. Monthly ×30, yearly ×365.
map.逐项校验空值与合法零值，单次跨层数不得超过楼层总数减 1；可填实际平均速度、启停: Each field is checked separately so blanks and valid zeros are handled differently; floors per trip may not exceed total floors minus 1. Actual average speed, start-stop overhead, regenerative recovery and a monthly meter reading can be entered for calibration. The model is linear and does not cover car counterweight differences, dispatching algorithms, VFD curves or statutory holidays.

map.4 部电梯 × 21.1 kWh × 365 天 ≈ 30,806 kWh，按: 4 lifts × 21.1 kWh × 365 days ≈ 30,806 kWh; at CNY 0.6/kWh the annual cost is about CNY 18,500. If the meter reads 700 kWh a month versus the 633 kWh estimate, it is about 10.6% higher; use the meter/estimate ratio to review the budget.
